title: Team — Content

fields.message: Team — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_team_hero_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_team_hero_heading
fields.instructions: The hero display headline. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line. This one is far under the budget, so it has the most room of the four. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.

fields.label: Sub copy — before the pink word
fields.name: brg_team_hero_sub_1
fields.instructions: Opening clause. The space before the pink word is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
fields.default_value: We're operators, leaders, community builders — and yes, we all have strong opinions about

fields.label: Sub copy — the pink word
fields.name: brg_team_hero_sub_highlight
fields.instructions: Rendered in brand pink, mid-sentence. One word or a very short phrase.

fields.label: Sub copy — after the pink word
fields.name: brg_team_hero_sub_2
fields.instructions: The rest of the sentence. Starts immediately after the pink word with no space, so begin with the punctuation.
fields.default_value: . This is the team behind the brands.

fields.label: Underline animation
fields.name: brg_team_hero_uline_variant
fields.instructions: How the hand-drawn underline (line-team-lg.svg) reveals. u3 (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe, keeps the taper. wipe straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback. u1 scaleX bar — this is what this hero used BEFORE the artwork swap, kept so the old look can be compared live. Unknown or blank renders the mark static and visible, never hidden. Catalogue: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: brg_team_hero_bg_photo
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave this empty and the hero keeps the flat dark color it has today — nothing changes until you choose a photo. The photo fills the whole hero and is cropped to fit, so its exact size does not matter; around 1920px on the long edge is plenty and anything bigger only slows the page. Light photos make white headlines hard to read, which is what the two overlay settings below are for. If you also set a background video below, this photo is what shows while the video loads and for anyone who has animation switched off.

fields.label: Overlay color
fields.name: brg_team_hero_overlay_color
fields.instructions: A flat color laid over the background photo to keep the headline readable. This does nothing when no photo is set. Choose None to turn the overlay off entirely.

fields.label: Overlay strength
fields.name: brg_team_hero_overlay_strength
fields.instructions: How much of the overlay color shows through. Only has an effect once an overlay color is chosen above. 45% is the usual setting for white type over a photo — go higher if the headline still fights the picture, lower if the photo is already dark.

fields.label: Background video (optional)
fields.name: brg_team_hero_video_id
fields.instructions: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank to use the photo above, or the flat hero color if there is no photo. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls. The photo shows while the video loads, if the video is blocked, and for visitors who have switched off animation — so it is worth setting one as well.

fields.label: Video from
fields.name: brg_team_hero_video_source
fields.instructions: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.

fields.label: Photo colour
fields.name: brg_team_hero_photo_tone
fields.instructions: Colour is the default and is almost always right — the photography on this site was black and white only because the placeholder images were. Switch a section to black and white when you want it that way on purpose. Only affects photographs; the brand icons and lockups keep their colour either way.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_team_members_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Show the divider icon
fields.name: brg_team_members_show_divider
fields.instructions: The round badge that sits between this section and the one above it. Untick to remove just the badge — the section itself stays.

fields.label: Team members
fields.name: brg_team_members_members
fields.instructions: One row per person, in the order they appear on the page. Drag to reorder. Until the first row is added the page keeps the nine placeholder cards it shows today.

sub_fields.label: Headshot
sub_fields.name: photo
sub_fields.instructions: Fills the card. Square or portrait crops sit best. No photo yet is fine — the card falls back to its color block.

sub_fields.label: Quote
sub_fields.name: quote
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, shown under the card. Leave blank for none.

sub_fields.label: Background color
sub_fields.name: bg_color
sub_fields.instructions: The color behind this person's cut-out. Leave on Automatic and the grid cycles through the brand colors by position, so adding or removing someone re-colors the rest on its own. Pick a specific color only when you want to override that.

sub_fields.label: Crop
sub_fields.name: crop
sub_fields.instructions: Which part of the photo to keep when it does not fit the box exactly. With Fit the height this moves the person left or right; with Fill the box it also decides which edges are trimmed. Bottom is usually right for a cut-out, so they stand on the base of the box.

choices.bottom: Bottom — stands on the base of the box

sub_fields.label: Let the photo hang outside the box
sub_fields.name: overflow
sub_fields.instructions: Normally the photo is trimmed at the edges of the colored box. Switch this on and anything wider than the box shows outside it — useful when something should break out of the frame, like a raised arm or a prop. Only does anything when How the photos fit is set to Fit the height; the other two settings always resolve inside the box.

choices.hidden: No — trim it at the edges

sub_fields.label: Keep this photo inside the box on hover
sub_fields.name: hovercrop
sub_fields.instructions: When someone hovers a card the photo normally lifts and the top of the head rises out of the colored box. Switch this on for a photo that is already cut off at the top — lifting it would only show the flat edge of the crop. The card still reacts: the color still shrinks and the photo still scales, it just stays inside the box.

choices.free: No — let the top lift out of the box

fields.label: Card shape
fields.name: brg_team_members_card_shape
fields.instructions: The shape of every photo box in the grid. This is one setting for the whole grid on purpose — a grid of mixed shapes reads as a mistake rather than a choice. Use the crop on each person to deal with how they sit inside it.

fields.label: How the photos fit
fields.name: brg_team_members_photo_fit
fields.instructions: How each cut-out sits in its box. Fit the height pins the photo to the full height of the box so everyone matches, and lets the width fall where it does — that is the setting the design is built around. Fill the box crops whichever edge is too big. Show the whole photo never crops, but people end up different sizes.

choices.height: Fit the height — everyone the same height, sides may crop
choices.cover: Fill the box — crops whichever edges overflow
choices.contain: Show the whole photo — nothing cropped, gaps at the sides

fields.label: Columns on a wide screen
fields.name: brg_team_members_columns
fields.instructions: How many people sit side by side on a desktop screen. Narrower screens step down on their own — two across on a tablet, one on a phone — so this is only the widest case. Four needs a genuinely wide window to be worth it; below about 1240px it falls back to three so the cards do not get too small for a face.

fields.label: Quote mark behind the quote
fields.name: brg_team_members_quote_mark
fields.instructions: A large quotation mark sitting behind each person's quote. Matching the card color keeps it quiet — it reads as texture rather than an element. Yellow is louder and the same on every card. Either way it only appears where a quote has been written.

choices.match: Match each person's card color — subtle
choices.yellow: Yellow — bolder, same on every card

fields.label: Photo colour
fields.name: brg_team_members_photo_tone
fields.instructions: Colour is the default and is almost always right — the photography on this site was black and white only because the placeholder images were. Switch a section to black and white when you want it that way on purpose. Only affects photographs; the brand icons and lockups keep their colour either way.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_team_apply_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: brg_team_apply_heading
fields.instructions: The question, in the display face at up to 3.5rem. Wraps inside 20ch by design, so length is forgiving — but past ~60 characters it starts pushing the band taller than the comp's proportions.
fields.default_value: Want to be part of the team?

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_team_apply_sub
fields.instructions: One paragraph beneath the heading, capped at 60ch. Plain text; markup is escaped.
fields.default_value: We're always looking for people who lead with heart, stay stoked under pressure, and believe a great guest experience starts with a great team experience.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: brg_team_apply_cta_label
fields.instructions: Black button on the teal band. ~18 characters.

fields.label: Button link
fields.name: brg_team_apply_cta_href
fields.instructions: Where the button goes. Defaults to the careers page.

description: Editable content for the Team page, one tab per section. Generated — edit website/sections/<id>/slots.json and rerun kit/build-acf.py.
